tweets.html: Just how much of an impact has Alex Bregman made to the Chicago Cubs during their torrid streak?They were 43-37 with Bregman hitting .244 and a .680 OPS after June 24.The Cubs since are 28-13 with Bregman hitting .280 and a .909 OPS with 10 HRs, 33 runs and 36 RBI.
